_comment: Per-family speculative-decoding eligibility for the managed llama-server. matchPrefixes use the canonical token form of sidecar/ai/app_profiles canonicalize_model_name (lowercase, non-alnum runs -> '-'). Families must stay in sync with sidecar/ai/app_profiles/__init__.py::_REGISTRY; tests/sidecar/ai/app_profiles/test_acceleration_catalog_parity.py enforces it. mtp is a tri-state claim: 'yes' = verified, 'unverified' = selectable only with allow_unverified (benchmark profiles), 'no' = never. mtpShape 'separate' means the drafter ships as its own GGUF matched by drafterPattern in the model directory. vramHeadroomMb is the extra GPU residency the mode costs.

families.evidence: unsloth gemma-4-12B-it-qat-GGUF ships mtp-gemma-4-12B-it.gguf (Q4_0, ~254 MB) and documents --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 4
Qwen-3.5 base family has native MTP heads; published Ornith 1.5 GGUF not yet confirmed to carry them
MoE variants show no net MTP speedup on consumer GPUs
